Name: Pretty Office Chairs 2 - Electric Boogaloo
Author: LadyZomkie
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37973]Pretty Office Chairs[/url] needed a sequel. For the cuties that just aren't into pastels. I started with the intent to make just dark ones, I dunno how I ended up with pink, pink and neon coral. 🤣

Just like Pretty Office Chairs 1, these are sold by Robin [i]and [/i]in the catalogue. I couldn't find actual names for some of the colors so I made stuff up sometimes, sorry. lmao

[b]Robin's shop schedule:[/b]
Monday - Black, red
Tuesday - Violet, pink
Wednesday - Neon coral, grey
Thursday - Dark pink, Cyan
Friday - Lime green, uggo yellow
Saturday - Dark cyan, RedBlack
Sunday - Blue, tan

They go nicely with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8518]modern farm computer[/url]. 😊

Downloads.Description: For the people that want more than pastel chairs.
